name: THE HOOK
spoken: They pay you two dollars to watch videos. Then they ask for two hundred fifty.

name: THE PIVOT
spoken: See, the job is real. The pay is real. The trap is the next step.

name: THE TRUST
spoken: Meaning the platform builds trust on purpose. Instant payouts. A balance that grows. Support that answers in minutes. None of it was real.

name: THE TRACE
spoken: But the balance on screen is not real. When you deposit two hundred fifty, the money moves. To their platform. Then to their wallet. Then gone.

name: THE FUNNEL
spoken: And the scam runs on volume. A hundred thousand targets. A thousand responses. A hundred deposits. Five locked accounts.

name: THE PAYOFF
spoken: Therefore, paid to watch videos. Until the pay becomes the price.
